timeline.text: Ask for a lesson on a tricky word, and it used to repeat the same point every section.
Now it maps distinct angles first, like a teacher outlining chapters, then writes one angle per section.
Every earlier section gets read back first, so no sentence repeats.
The AI even checks its own work, and rewrites automatically if a word lesson runs thin.
That target word now shows up in at least 10 of every 16 lines.
